<li data-list-item-id="e93022ccfbd8466009a27ab04e23227d2"><code>aspect_ratio_change</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0e9cb7abebbe058a7427dad4dfbd8cf3">
<code>historical_context</code> – Previous conversation context or editing history (edit mode only).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edaf230b1cb6ed1e358c9adf07ff750a8">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1c12ac7eb5680131f05e68b485ca2bbf"><em>Generate a picture of a futuristic city at sunset.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9eb03d9ddaad37fdf5df0562439d11b9"><em>Edit this image to remove the person in the background.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6392d0a677afa81ce4abb08821a4ef84"><em>Change the style of this photo to a watercolor painting.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e30327c5413795b1d0b9a4bb5369eb64e"><em>Create three variations of this product image with different lighting.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9f9a0da51f990680eb97f86942e80a1b"><em>Add a dog to the image at 'image_link_1'.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<details><summary><code>analyze_image_content</code> – Uses AI to understand and analyze the content of images, including screenshots or images found through web searches, and answers questions based on the visual information.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2d8d204ad4616233ee1e430a9f2eb9e9">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3c005747a4b8bebde10a2e8646643584">When you have an image (for example, a screenshot or a generated image) and need to extract information or ask specific questions about its content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9a73996810608cdd9f88469a2fa38477">To get a description or analysis of what is depicted in an image.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e02b15babb8c6fdfd119979e89b40d2f5">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7e0d442e5fea999c6cf5d6d6428109d2">
<code>file_id</code> – The ID of the image file to be analyzed. This file should exist in the Opal backend (for instance, from a previous upload or generation).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3d2363fbc44aceacb6b7406ae0d4ae2a">
<code>query</code> – The specific question or analysis request you have about the image (for example, W<em>hat is the main subject? </em>or <em>Describe the colors used</em>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e95ba266cf2c19e38142aa6deff627ba2">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb44850cf2c5d7d1eba807892db908f08"><em>What is in this image?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1d3336be13f28fec79f934d415bbc28e"><em>Describe this product.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb340f4ffb38057121b81f685a5a44055"><em>What is happening here?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details></details><h3 id="search-find">Keywords<a class="link-anchor" href="#search-find"></a></h3><details><summary><code>figure_out_search_keywords</code> – Generates 8-15 related search keywords for comprehensive information about a topic, presented in a markdown table format.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed82dbec33eee045b7a203a4eaed5e134">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efd2b2ba5faa2ba674457091e4c6a37bd">When you need to determine effective keywords for a search based on a user's natural language query.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7aa41fdd5023b03b1f233ba25d02373a">When you want to understand the core components of a  request to formulate precise search queries for other tools (like <code>search_web</code> or <code>search_optimizely_docs</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee1765c0c9a619268c80554544bb3cf34">To break down a complex query into actionable search terms.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed0c68b24d8f6801eb87be12bb26a558d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="e56d7e6edc85bc79837ab49face12c6be">
<code>user_query</code> – The query for which the search keywords need to be generated.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e73b943f1df0b02ece295c2b171010ad6">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1158bbeb1ab4b12b33bfe9775047bf21"><em>Figure out search keywords for "Optimizely product features and benefits".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb55ac74a896c476ce763fe18a2e0c694"><em>What are the best keywords to search for information on "A/B testing best practices"?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6620ba029695f219fd1704016362a3f5"><em>Help me find search terms for "How to integrate Optimizely with Google Analytics".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><h3 id="h_01K7MVQKWZJC0V81VT3QXQZC0Z">Remote Development Environment (RDE)<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01K7MVQKWZJC0V81VT3QXQZC0Z"></a></h3><details><summary><code>rde_attach_instance</code> – Attach an existing RDE instance to the conversation.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6aed406dc38f8f63b76845c93af2e30f">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eaffb497cc3dfa02a54149c1bea945ef4">Connect an already running Remote Development Environment (RDE) to the current chat session.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e86ccae185c090cfebd36e71c218b9db4">Enable <code>code_execute</code> and workspace tools to interact with an existing codebase or development environment.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaa41bb4e167a658dd134327f1931c64f">Reassign an active RDE instance from another conversation to the current one for continued work.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e372c51b1f3c36aa04033175db876cb6c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="e0fe8788ae43f254a2ff48ed4f5fb4f1f">
<code>instance_id</code> – RDE instance ID to attach.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e343aefae2de81f33f919067849f24830">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e90fd222799224721a93414eec2c08a4f">
<em>Please attach my existing RDE instance, for example, using the ID </em><code><em>inst-12345</em></code><em>.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec2efabaf47948862122ee33e9fa93911">
<em>Can you connect the dev environment we used yesterday to this chat, for example, instance </em><code><em>inst-67890</em></code><em>?</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec6c0519dd443f088307eed293fc932dc">
<em>I want to run some code in my running RDE, for example, attach instance </em><code><em>inst-abcde</em></code><em> so we can continue debugging.</em>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>rde_create_instance</code> – Create a new RDE instance from a template and attach it to this conversation.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edcd280f9b779a406eae6a44c4ae1feb7">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec7499683b091cd241165f41a1c9ebb72">Provision a brand new development environment based on a predefined template.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec755e995eea1fd7b0c4aa5d965af9e37">Download repository code and configure tools and runtimes for a new project in the workspace.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e943b2b272dc29d548cdfa3659bbbee07">Initialize an RDE so you can start executing code or searching the codebase from scratch.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e658bf8be43d57e6bb158f7b5317480e4">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebb67c547053acb724ba6da9d02322ae1">
<code>name</code> – Human-readable name for this instance.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6ac2080f05ad4ec5e376b8d6467d929b">
<code>template_id</code> – Template ID from <code>rde_list_templates</code> tool.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0c736cbbc1338b41fb3c70b2d4cc8197">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee319ce4266f77799e3aa1fef5441448b">
<em>Create a new development environment for the frontend project, for example, using template </em><code><em>tmpl-react-app</em></code><em> and name it "My React Dev".</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eff1d08a3e5bacb5b8bd16fec5da147a1">
<em>I need a new RDE for data analysis, for example, use the </em><code><em>tmpl-data-science</em></code><em> template and call it "Data Workspace".</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1eeb1b7613c73e8f58131bca470457aa">
<em>Please provision a new instance from the backend template, for example, named "API Service" with ID </em><code><em>tmpl-node-backend</em></code><em>.</em>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>rde_list_templates</code> – List available RDE templates.</summary><div><ul>

<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea2aecd447dcdfc8c88efcce43325ce62">

<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eca036fd2eb26d0c1e5df33a2467c9a99"><em>What RDE templates are available for me to use?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4374772210e31cb1180cae8a102daad6"><em>Can you list the development environment templates, for example, so I can find the one for Python projects?</em></li>

</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KTC7RAYNAQX5RF3YQAWHJ20X">Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KTC7RAYNAQX5RF3YQAWHJ20X"></a></h3><p>RAG tools only display on Opal instances where RAG is provisioned.</p><div class="note">The <code>search_application_data</code> tool is retired. It has been replaced by the <code>rag_retrieve_from_cmp</code> tool.</div><details><summary><code>rag_retrieve_from_cmp</code> – Searches your Optimizely CMP data, campaigns, tasks, assets, work requests, and briefs, using semantic similarity and SQL-based queries. Returns results as structured data for use in conversation responses.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb3f08b2435dcdd583c290db47d3e8c7a">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef4bbbe641906cc10e3c08c184c0a86f7">Finding specific campaigns, tasks, or assets in CMP.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edf5d55d07c16b31bea7ee00d96bf9e26">Retrieving campaign briefs or task details.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee73b07d685e148b78c5bd63c93b9ace0">Searching content across your CMP workspace by topic, label, or category.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e8527bfe4d90f18a49cfa8500baa894">Pulling context for content creation or planning.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2269df726e3435235d96ebf58c78b6b1">Answering questions like "our blogs", "assets assigned to me", or "overdue tasks".</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e65b1279c742eb84c06339ede80869c11">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef784cbc06d8bef877523bd4bca55a72a">
<code>query</code> – Natural language description of the content to find. Example: "Find campaigns related to summer marketing".</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efd4242c91d32ecd0f7237fc0f2a741ce">(Optional) <code>resource_types</code> – Filter by resource type: <code>asset</code>, <code>campaign</code>, <code>task</code>, <code>work_request</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6050ab3d2a74cbc5abc6955774c8a851">(Optional) <code>asset_types</code> – Filter by asset type: <code>image</code>, <code>video</code>, <code>pdf</code>, <code>article</code>, and so on.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e13ab3e5bd30734704d3d3783f6a6c45b">(Optional) <code>status</code> – Filter by status values such as <code>On Hold</code>, <code>Overdue</code>, <code>In Progress</code>, <code>Done</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb8858b66337f16fbf0c4973dc23cfe32">(Optional) <code>assignees</code> – Filter by assignee name, email, or ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edad3f6da237fa38d166360fe27b01ec2">(Optional) <code>owners</code> – Filter by owner name, email, or ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee5fc03e72a1b79647cf45e678cf9e87c">(Optional) <code>creators</code> – Filter by creator name, email, or ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3e458247ac21e04452f6bb6377e3da79">(Optional) <code>date_filters</code> – Date range filters specifying a field, start date, and end date.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e994ac0f7e77ab03c2fd5822b6e0a586f">(Optional) <code>field_filters</code> – Custom field or label filters using a field ID and value.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e52aca1f6fffc18dae21eabcca9763181">(Optional) <code>limit</code> – Maximum number of results to return.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e26999f5ad508c194905687042db1ef52">(Optional) <code>chat_history</code> – Previous conversation context for multi-turn queries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e95fb624778da3e4e51dac80a2190e52e">(Optional) <code>thread_id</code> – Thread ID for conversation tracking.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0311278d3f93f410d546f4682350bcfe">(Optional) <code>agent_execution_id</code> – Agent execution ID for request tracing.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e48e581acc1c964d1c4e2031ffaf87805">
<strong>Example prompt</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8e4161d1c48a0cda366134178736e9d8"><em>Show me all overdue tasks assigned to Sarah.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4fd97007f6c8e4a715e21a2707de2978"><em>What campaigns are currently at risk?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed96cc0021f60c5c59c0f6fc4bbf3441e"><em>Find all video assets created this month related to our product launch.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><code>rag_retrieve_from_cmp_as_csv</code> – Searches your Optimizely CMP data, campaigns, tasks, assets, work requests, and briefs, using semantic similarity and SQL-based queries. Returns results as tabular CSV data. </summary><ul>

<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e29e1e521c51a9def12f390e301956705">

<code>query</code> – Natural language description of the content to find. Example: "All assets created in Q3".</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eca379e7ce2cd21156bafdf66a698c61a">(Optional) <code>resource_types</code> – Filter by resource type: <code>asset</code>, <code>campaign</code>, <code>task</code>, <code>work_request</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6cee41309adda4e1b295a187af732903">(Optional) <code>asset_types</code> – Filter by asset type: <code>image</code>, <code>video</code>, <code>pdf</code>, <code>article</code>, and so on.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e80ffd3e73053f6463ca3ebb46cab32d7">(Optional) <code>status</code> – Filter by status values such as <code>On Hold</code>, <code>Overdue</code>, <code>In Progress</code>, <code>Done</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9d6630ad0411e679d37bbcbe4354db9b">(Optional) <code>assignees</code> – Filter by assignee name, email, or ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eee41aad58f59a281930c40f43d48400c">(Optional) <code>owners</code> – Filter by owner name, email, or ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5ef762cb1da5bd28b0755855313ac60d">(Optional) <code>creators</code> – Filter by creator name, email, or ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed8b07166929883ad1ce54cc078afc355">(Optional) <code>date_filters</code> – Date range filters specifying a field, start date, and end date.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edad9386aed55ca0a7b8ea86583b8e3ea">(Optional) <code>field_filters</code> – Custom field or label filters using a field ID and value.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee497d0022bb9060445c3a411d73d0363">(Optional) <code>limit</code> – Maximum number of results to return.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6458b15637676d487147baf0a7a043f8">(Optional) <code>chat_history</code> – Previous conversation context for multi-turn queries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e16b6220d786b0a503b76e7c544e9cf89">(Optional) <code>thread_id</code> – Thread ID for conversation tracking.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee9464486ca40b6e0b0de4d664c202193">(Optional) <code>agent_execution_id</code> – Agent execution ID for request tracing.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9543fa87ea3493ea0043f260d0272439">
<strong>Example prompt</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7b8049a54e4db5584bbe3309e2a3f978"><em>Export a table of all image assets tagged with 'brand' created last month.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6676fbd59a06aec09691ba361000844f"><em>Give me a report of all in-progress tasks assigned to the design team this quarter.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed82e30a0d88d34d14688f530e6b201c9"><em>Export all work requests submitted in the last 30 days.</em></li>

</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><code>rag_retrieve_from_optimizely_graph</code> – Search for relevant information in your CMP and CMS data using RAG for Optimizely Graph. The tool provides powerful search, filtering, and content delivery capabilities for your applications. The tool can return both structured documents (like content items) and unstructured analytical data, depending on your query.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6700eb8c52323a5dfa31cd24905bc6e4">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e68e185a90514962410280f22cf43e87c">Search for content across your Optimizely products (CMS, CMP).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e72ecf2a5aa45baa5146d8ea22be413b4">Find specific content, such as articles, products, or experiments.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e961e9d0692cd0200f652712019e5e67f">Get analytics or summary data from Optimizely Graph.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edd87e4c41e06a91ab325346fdaa5b2c8">Power headless content delivery for mobile or web applications.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e119772d6f8412712254acc255698a7ae">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebfa275c2c7f49be691b2bb399e4221f4">
<code>query</code> – Search query to find relevant application data in CMP or CMS.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5f64a7fe60c6422d363a11ac5e3cff4d">(Optional) <code>chat_history</code> – Previous conversation context for better search results.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8f46e6ca54e969fb908d57c04cbe5da2">(Optional) <code>thread_id</code> – Thread identifier for conversation continuity.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edb00e84bbc5f33d4892e15b15b54a2f5">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9250eedef2d484db3ebc1433b1e99feb"><em>Find content related to 'winter promotions'.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3febb4fced670217d7241a55fe6e974a"><em>Show me analytics for the latest homepage experiment.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed85939628d2142fb85f52dd2699c6f5f"><em>What features are enabled for US users?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><h3 id="h_01K7PWT88CPTKP15FMG3D611M0">Search<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01K7PWT88CPTKP15FMG3D611M0"></a></h3><details><summary><code>search_optimizely_docs</code> – Searches Optimizely public documentation (end-user and developer documentation) and summarizes relevant content.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e43dbb3571c1789542e305235f3f0ebd6">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eeca896fb735883ef5d27f4447a31b942">Understand how to perform a specific task within an Optimizely product.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e020c1032d8328feb72f2d608a1f119b0">Search the Optimizely knowledge base or documentation for answers to your questions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e30c49af346400d0f1e8355e962aae90d">Find steps, procedures, or details about product features that are likely covered in support documentation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eef225dfeb73d25bd5d0c7bad638e9145">Clarify or supplement your understanding of a topic if you are unsure about an answer.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3c4aa6e0f92753081647ebccb769b9ff">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="eaea3c1950c80b4c740a8016c8527210b">
<code>query</code> – The search query you want to use to find information in the Optimizely knowledge base.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee98ba9a660686f6589e20bf71ac8e719">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2eaa7c78c374ad444be14f6423c3da2f"><em>How do I create a new experiment in Optimizely Web Experimentation?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e720b577dacc8642edd434d670e89df0f"><em>Tell me about the different types of content in Optimizely CMS.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e03c2a8ba271e806004bb4d9b564bc54e"><em>What are the steps to integrate Optimizely Feature Experimentation with a React application?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3d9095021078696149e53a4c01de5951"><em>Search the documentation for information on A/B testing best practices.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9323fe3fdaeb3e7dd2c5cc9ff169e847"><em>I need to know how to set up metrics in Personalization.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><code>search_web</code> – Searches the web for a given query using Google.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9f63a8bfb654db5006c6c8ba159ea3c0">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ecebe2d32d4f75c1f336b7831cdd1d169">Find general information, news, or external resources related to marketing, experimentation, or digital experience.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6973c76408e68b75c9fea26530fff55a">Look for best practices, industry trends, or competitive analysis that extends beyond Optimizely's product features.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec3fbc06d6805cdf00fe9b25484ba4723">Search for images or other media files.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3189fe61cd986a9e6f1c3ff5a4de8d90">Gather information from specific websites (site search).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed805ebd391dfda18d750447237da8464">Find definitions or explanations of general concepts.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e48690cc07a886a06158731398898e92d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed56b76cc84bc308a96ce354a26052770">
<code>search_query</code> – The main query you want to search for.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9fe9c681d34fcc2401b8f7b20acd3044">(Optional) <code>num_results</code> – The number (integer) of search results you want to retrieve.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4cee0d41f83df695527d282334dc7ded">(Optional) <code>country_code</code> – A two-letter ISO country code (for example, 'us' or 'gb') to localize your search results.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e83cc3fab19f08b4bd4625ede2213105a">(Optional) <code>exact_terms</code> – A phrase that all documents in the search results must contain.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efcd8b6f4e37a4a20f3af8e8c0951fe9b">(Optional) <code>exclude_terms</code> – A word or phrase that must not appear in the search results.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0f3167d63dedbf5ca984fc72a9cf0318">(Optional) <code>file_type</code> – If you are looking for specific file formats (for example, 'pdf' or 'docx').</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5c149d20848d39099412454f1d35b80f">(Optional )<code>site_search</code> – Specifies a particular website to include or exclude from the search results (for example, 'optimizely.com').</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5a952cb2967da49ba29be67951175584">(Optional) <code>search_type</code> – Set to 'image' if you are looking for images.<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb921853b8b940a54b3806e12924d7527">(Optional) <code>image_size</code> – If <code>search_type</code> is 'image', you can specify the desired image size (for example, 'large', 'medium', or 'icon').</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e62e7c1cbcd639b9ab9fb9ec3218eb473">(Optional) <code>image_type</code> – If <code>search_type</code> is 'image', you can specify the desired image type (for example, 'photo', 'clipart', or 'face').</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ece9945a2ea91e4930c83d3aa90699ba2">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e11e4d8470026b33df2123eb8ea848f0e"><em>What are the latest trends in e-commerce personalization?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4db93dc90d5c25ff2c15651ac79f4de2"><em>Find articles about A/B testing strategies.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef38a73873eed947cfbc2035a68e5721c"><em>Search for images of successful landing page designs.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e248f49b0c846d3b80a309fb3788e4808"><em>What is the definition of 'customer lifetime value'?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec0f90ad954366cd43d9827e37a33f234"><em>Find information on optimizely.com about feature flags.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef98c6dac906ebd21803ffd836f346f59"><em>Search for marketing automation tools, excluding HubSpot.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><h3 id="h_01K7MKZ82913WZJ5N891STHBWS">Skills management<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01K7MKZ82913WZJ5N891STHBWS"></a></h3><details><summary><code>create_or_edit_skill</code> – Create or edit a personal or organization-level skill in Opal.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8200bc9f330fdf28cf4b2f4ed971bf91">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efc1087e96750c6db528411a10b5647fc">Save the current conversation or instructions as a new personal skill, for example, to reuse specific formatting rules.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecef64b8c91c24dd495e36b35173aa43c">Edit an existing skill, for example, to update its title, content, or add a shortcut handle.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee59b117650d7501b23931210d5be8def">Make a set of instructions available organization-wide by creating an organization skill.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efef75e2fab25cdf77d68ea4aa157c34e">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e695d4a182b1569dcc94e5df96b16542e">
<code>skill_type</code> – 'personal' for individual use; 'org' for organization-wide visibility. Default to 'personal' for new skills unless specified. On edits, preserve the original type — type changes require creating a new skill.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ba6b4a90e8c0a198c6ceb60a00f73b8">(Optional) <code>active</code> – Whether the skill is active in chat. New skills are active by default. On edits, omit unless explicitly changing — omitting preserves the existing state.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec2a8051596f5994e8dd20a48e0ecbd95">
<p>(Optional) <code>files</code> – Files to attach to this skill. Only set this when the user has attached files to the chat or you have file_ids from a prior tool result — never guess or fabricate file_id values. Pass a list of SkillFile objects, one per file:</p>
<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec6fb5b78de95567d3fc89c496ded6a56">
<code>filename</code> – just the name with extension (for example, 'accept_changes.py'). Must not contain spaces.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb6744c9f3ae4e518d7c1b60b390d85b5">
<code>file_path</code> – full relative storage path including filename and extension. If no subfolder is specified, file_path == filename. Must not contain spaces.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6fd27644f1f246cb816e3c7d02184d4a">
<code>file_id</code> – opaque file ID from the chat attachment context.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed2403a0a9d1dad33ef9d4763194d528a">
<code>mime_type</code> – MIME type from the chat attachment.</li>
</ul>
<p>Editing the file list:</p>
<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e54add238eba7a223ae8b670d325de9c1">Add a file: call get_skill first, merge new entries with the existing list, pass the full list</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e482788d2dceb3647eafe70fea852a52a">Remove a file: call get_skill, drop that entry, pass the remaining list</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9e930c1ff580b7fee30ae4f546cf417c">Clear all files: pass an explicit empty list []</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e080d9845f11d90cdb051147c83b22b0c">Omit (null) to preserve existing files unchanged</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e66c68b2074c64b8910f027778ff8ffff">(Optional) <code>instance_id</code> – Instance ID to scope the skill. Include only when the user specifies an instance scope. On edits, omit unless explicitly changing — omitting preserves the existing value.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea1938d814abaecafde4438ed5675d14a">(Optional) <code>mention_handle</code> – Shortcut handle for invoking this skill in chat, without the / prefix (for example, 'translate-dothraki'). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens. If a conflict occurs on save, inform the user and suggest an alternative.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee8285049908a55ff3f3c6f9abbb5dfef">(Optional) <code>product_sku</code> – Product SKU to scope the skill. Include only when the user specifies a product scope.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e85407b9914c4a45f0853442ac9793c65">(Optional) <code>skill</code> – Full skill text derived from the conversation. Write as a self-contained directive the agent can follow, including which tools to use and how. Required when creating a new skill. On edits, omit unless explicitly changing — omitting preserves the existing skill content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2a634bc88cd21861fc477b0ebab2ae4e">(Optional) <code>skill_id</code> – Existing skill GUID for edits. Omit to create a new skill.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed8892735886a170a944abfd5603ae6f8">(Optional) <code>title</code> – Concise human-readable name for the skill (for example, 'Translate to Dothraki'). Separate from mention_handle. Required when creating a new skill. On edits, omit unless explicitly changing — omitting preserves the existing title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e14b4617c396b20a84dabe43b3b24ce99">(Optional) <code>trigger_conditions</code> – Human-readable description of when to apply this skill, inferred from context.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eca341180df85c59870b29ba0aabe9357">(Optional) <code>trigger_tools</code> – Tools whose presence in the session automatically activates this skill.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec37c68ab924851626fae494c06a48525">(Optional) <code>trigger_type</code> – How this skill is activated: 'keyword' triggers on matching phrases; 'tool' triggers when specific tools are present in the session. On edits, omit unless explicitly changing — omitting preserves the existing value.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e298d02baefd3efd643150ac8730c415a">(Optional) <code>update_summary</code> – Brief summary of changes when editing, in present tense (for example, 'Add shortcut', 'Update skill content').</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef37a4ba3198e3f28910992c4a8ae8062">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5365dc389a9a6a32a8f15140cd219771"><em>Save this entire conversation as a skill, for example, naming it "Weekly Report Generator".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e588999c8ddff9cbda86372c5d2bf8a21"><em>Edit my AmaWaterways skill, for example, by updating the instructions to include a new formatting rule.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4b6ad33cbafdac3a25dff1f0c56efce0"><em>Add a shortcut to my editing skill, for example, using the handle "edit-docs".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>find_skill</code> – Search existing Opal skills by free-text query. Read-only.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eec578d5080787c208914d04cc0bd9abf">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebf78af2c691cd31528576f9923ac17a4">Locate a specific skill you referenced by name or shortcut, for example, so you can edit it.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1c2d04141474910f93b894f8ac02c911">Check if a similar skill already exists before creating a new one, for example, to avoid duplicates.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3cdf7b54d72cdcb2929a4e0f188e7cd3">Search through your personal or organization skills to find an active skill set.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e708e522ecf5c496259d86b5b7227e80a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec1ad83a1964a3e791687c295665763e2">
<code>query</code> – Free-text query matched as a case-insensitive substring against each skill's title, content, and shortcut. Whitespace-separated terms are <code>AND</code>ed together. Prefer a single distinctive keyword over a full phrase.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1c7562a6a9552e1b49982ae639a559a8">(Optional) <code>kind</code> – Restrict the search to personal or organization skills. Omit to search both (subject to permissions).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e49ba264bb8e3feb1cdf9c8711920e6a1">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2ad7bebfcb8959f0582a3bb5eb8511ba"><em>Find my skill related to daily standups, for example, searching for the keyword "standup".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e89251ba92f616e4d40813aef3327a2f6"><em>Check if there is an organization skill for translating text, for example, querying "translate".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0cc97efc971554d4ecd0d1146f027ac1"><em>Can you locate the skill I use for formatting markdown, for example, so we can edit it?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>get_skill</code> – Fetch the full definition of a single Opal skill by its GUID. Read-only.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4ca94ea9f9429bf805bf04cc532ab8d6">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9258a92e721e1341902d3caf52ec0b66">Retrieve the full content and definition of a skill using its GUID, for example, after locating it with the <code>find_skill</code> tool.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4bd49a0715c4692258746700d4550aa0">Check a skill's current configuration before proposing an update, for example, so you can compute the exact edit needed.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4a2ee1d87a57a43be64d7a5ca6df485d">Review the specific instructions saved inside a personal or org skill.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1af2f120a5e95ef93771c6a1f214eadd">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="ef2c463fd485dbc8eb2822b3d64219af6">
<code>skill_guid</code> – The GUID of the skill to fetch (the <code>skill_guid</code> returned by the <code>find_skill</code> tool).</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef6b9908f070d1624143268ca20e10a4c">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eac98eae001ad7e9ae24104fe34644c03">
<em>Fetch the full definition of the skill, for example, using the GUID </em><code><em>123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000</em></code><em>.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec290e3d6b0db06e7a57fdd2521b010df"><em>Get the current details of my writing skill, for example, so we can modify the tone instructions.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb0c76dbd095bb5d023ea6a08ee2c1ce2">
<em>Can you retrieve the organization skill content, for example, by passing its specific </em><code><em>skill_guid</em></code><em>?</em>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KTC8D1QKH4EY83KNDHG5ZC1F">Webpage analysis<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KTC8D1QKH4EY83KNDHG5ZC1F"></a></h3><details><summary><code>analyze_pagespeed</code> – Analyze a webpage's performance, SEO, or accessibility using <a href="https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/insights/v5/about" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Google PageSpeed Insights</a>. </summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb45a84b27c47ffdb85cdeba1c4d99ded">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e51ede2454dae0dbdb128a126b5a12c20">Before launching a new webpage or website, to ensure it meets performance, SEO, and accessibility standards.</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="eba1db423f3023ea1d0a115fe0dfe819e">When a webpage is experiencing slow loading times, high bounce rates, or poor user engagement, to identify underlying technical issues.</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="ef22534eff47cee8156b5e306280e9bfc">To regularly check and improve the accessibility of a website, ensuring it is usable by individuals with disabilities.</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="eb9da35bd7142ade7b5442c94139062a0">To identify technical SEO opportunities and issues that might be impacting search engine rankings.</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="ea344a89acaa06ded52c60a2088406552">After implementing performance or SEO improvements, to verify their effectiveness and measure the impact.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e78de666a07ec438e9f500ba47ba2781c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul data-axiom="1.7.1">
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e64c81e608abe1324fe009752c4bcc05e">
<code data-axiom="1.7.1">url</code> – The URL of the webpage to analyze.</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e278a125f7d3215194cb4e6cc09194ffa">
<code data-axiom="1.7.1">analysis_type</code> – The type of audit to perform. It can be one of the following:<ul data-axiom="1.7.1">
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e8a1c1b65f62619afea013092c1911f1c">
<code data-axiom="1.7.1">'seo_audit'</code> – Technical SEO analysis with performance metrics (SEO + Performance categories).</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e9b2e5f93275a201cc5354ac17ce99e3c">
<code data-axiom="1.7.1">'accessibility'</code> – Accessibility audit (WCAG/ARIA compliance).</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e75b5aa17e43b455f5767e277181f176f">
<code data-axiom="1.7.1">'page_speed'</code> – Page speed and performance analysis (Performance + Best Practices categories).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="eb574f4c4ea5abd6d3d1585eb1862dfdf">(Optional) <code data-axiom="1.7.1">device</code> – The device to emulate for the analysis. It can be <code data-axiom="1.7.1">'desktop'</code> or <code data-axiom="1.7.1">'mobile'</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e60412b5a92521047727feff25766a0f3">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e9c88d9bdab186e9863c1587f06c281f0">
<em>Can you run a page speed analysis for </em><code data-axiom="1.7.1"><em>https://www.optimizely.com</em></code><em> on mobile?</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e6521add6ebb9a7d090394a43ee677217">
<em>I need an SEO audit for my new product page at </em><code data-axiom="1.7.1"><em>https://www.example.com/products/new-product</em></code><em>.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e7c19b5a82128e8a09e25b17e3144897f">
<em>Check the accessibility of our homepage </em><code data-axiom="1.7.1"><em>https://www.mycompany.com</em></code><em>.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e286ed295992d0b77f678f185b9aaf5b3">
<em>Give me a performance report for </em><code data-axiom="1.7.1"><em>https://blog.optimizely.com</em></code><em> on desktop.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-axiom="1.7.1" data-list-item-id="e2f07ddb5b8dba5f6a130de50306e8f9a">
<em>Perform an SEO and performance audit for </em><code data-axiom="1.7.1"><em>https://www.marketingcampaign.com/landing-landing-landing-landing.page</em></code><em>.</em>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><h2 id="h_01KBG15973ZHZ7EN5Y86PV1DFW">System tools in beta<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KBG15973ZHZ7EN5Y86PV1DFW"></a></h2><p>Tools labeled <strong>Preview</strong> are not available in Opal Chat by default and are in beta. Contact your Customer Success Manager to add your instance to the beta and then Opal administrators can go to the <strong>Tools</strong> tab and enable them in Opal Chat.</p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1198/680;" src="/hc/article_attachments/46906450342413" width="1198" height="680" alt="Screenshot of the System Tools with the preview label highlighted." class="img-enlargable"></figure><h3 id="h_01K7MQATXPKBQRPKBMMRWBZVWE">Video<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01K7MQATXPKBQRPKBMMRWBZVWE"></a></h3><div class="beta">The video tools are in beta. Contact your Customer Success Manager for more information.</div><details><summary><code>generate_video</code> – Generates videos from text descriptions and optional starting images. It supports various aspect ratios and durations, and includes automatic prompt enhancement and audio generation.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efc4539d68b6a4a8fa0e28797e41bcce0">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea24bb6fc3dfd3eb763f9769c1aab0018">Create a new video based on a textual description.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e07278a880d4b15261dbdd236d6b029ae">Generate a video using an existing image as a starting point.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7886a522e09a6fbef9cf85ee13502894">Produce video content for marketing, social media, or other digital experiences.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9f7a48ace3fb9b531c91d23b2c0b3c6a">Experiment with different video styles, durations, or aspect ratios.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5d95d2b97ff7e6175d512da97e57a1f2">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9f3198103cdd855cad959bf5c90df196">
<code>prompt</code> – A text description of the video you want to generate.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eecea7accfe405005ebd6156764b42f04">(Optional) <code>starting_image_link</code> – The URL or link to a starting image to be used for image-to-video generation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e36cda7b8c404b4e5cac1e4f20f6a7535">(Optional <code>aspect_ratio</code> – The aspect ratio of the video. Options include '16:9' (Widescreen), '9:16' (Portrait), or '1:1' (Square). If not specified, it defaults to '16:9'.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaf2bb9666bdfe4e2e9ab2f8f91073680">(Optional) <code>duration_seconds</code> – The desired duration of the video in seconds. Options are 4 or 8. If not specified, it defaults to 8 seconds.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e89adb305c3e1dd0f71bf43e05cde8cc9">(Optional) <code>generate_audio</code> – Set to <code>True</code> to include audio generation in the video. If not specified, it defaults to <code>True</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee82bf7261a4a06e142bc98782e2e0f5a">(Optional) <code>generation_mode</code> – Determines the balance between generation speed and quality. Options are 'standard' or 'fast'. If not specified, it defaults to 'standard'.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee46bcdf7dda2050681d1204735d3b171">(Optional) <code>number_of_videos</code> – The number of video variations to generate. You can request 1 or 2 variations. If not specified, it defaults to 1.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2ef163b975e266a9921646b794d50d29">(Optional) <code>resolution</code> – The resolution of the video. Options are '1080p' or '720p'. If not specified, it defaults to '1080p'.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee37650e5b93deef04df29c3228553388">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea6eab8028b805dee6b4a78c9330daa83"><em>Generate a video of a futuristic city at sunset.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e466b3efc9002505f9b03b815d532e228"><em>Create a 16:9 video, 8 seconds long, showing a product being unboxed.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e328c23827f825db165be51a5918132b3">
<em>Generate a video from this image: </em><code><em>https://example.com/image.jpg</em></code><em> with a prompt about a serene forest.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eee334c70a69ec5f40a20f01fafe10ede"><em>Make a short portrait video (9:16) of a person dancing.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee9d894078e51370737d5e814ce8b9662"><em>Generate two variations of a video about a new software feature.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><h3 id="h_01KR1ZR3HPDMDAC03CKT7R3721">User input<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KR1ZR3HPDMDAC03CKT7R3721"></a></h3><div class="beta">The user input tools are in beta. Contact your Customer Success Manager for more information.</div><details><summary><code>ask_agent_input</code> – Collects a specialized agent's required parameters from the user before execution by presenting a structured input form in the chat interface.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0e49c25a0ccbcf90a9562c2327f46e7c">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e016962acad88701db4eefa1e2983e823">You @mentions a specialized agent but has do not provide all required parameters.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4587a05627ce9e209574a75a5910cde">Collect structured inputs for an agent that requires multiple fields before it can run.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e11b13fbec290b28933c381b034300d14">Pre-populate a form with known values so the user only needs to fill in the remaining fields.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1f5f0ba378c3ad8b4377e7e75c83a1c1">Gather file uploads, boolean flags, and text inputs together in a single form before agent execution.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6c0b8590e9e82306c28bebdbe32f2110">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea759f74d3f46d75f640f89bb186477ce">
<code>agent</code> – JSON object with agent info. Must have <code>name</code> and <code>description</code>. Optionally include <code>agent_id</code> and <code>is_system_agent</code> (boolean).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2aa05ea0605330c67b7813129cb57c31">
<code>parameters</code> – JSON array of parameter objects. Each object must have: <code>name</code>, <code>description</code>, <code>type</code>, <code>required</code> (boolean). Optionally include <code>placeholder</code>, <code>value</code> Example: <code>[{"name": "Campaign Name", "description": "Name of the campaign", "type": "string", "required": true, "placeholder": "for example, spring-sale"}, {"name": "Source Document", "description": "PDF or text to summarize", "type": "file", "required": true}]</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5a30aa58cb622c350ecf5a13e1b91c5c">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e31bde8ec9d49f6a9ae5bc147a9e48c48"><em>Run the UTM Creation agent to build a tracking link for our upcoming webinar.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e33dcec82627b4590971edd44f5a1720f"><em>I want to use the Campaign Brief Generator agent, can you collect the inputs I need to provide?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efc14016fe507294301d1386d27133130"><em>Launch the SEO Analyzer agent on my landing page draft.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eecd7db59b1f2b6f1ee29b8c4d9ea120b"><em>Use the Image Resizer agent to resize my banner. I’ll upload the file now.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ecefeb2091c8154636c449128a59255ff"><em>Kick off the Audience Segment Builder agent for our EMEA campaign.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><code>ask_user_question</code> – Presents the user with one or more structured questions and selectable options to gather input before proceeding with a task.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebe65e54129afa5eda3ed2a8a4b757d7d">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb8acb5d0470f07d95d4072ebd02a4fd1">A request is ambiguous and requires clarification before taking action.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed6805382f86c8483b57953bf59709e74">Present the user with a defined set of options to choose from instead of asking open-ended questions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9dccac7cc975c8b127d632bd988f93ab">Gather preferences, such as tone, format, or target audience, before generating content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eecaf762107ac9f95d5bc7d359498f6b4">Let users select multiple applicable options, for example the channels a campaign should target.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0bb6e0bcb579597acd1c55db409ee056">Resolve ambiguity when two or more valid approaches exist and a user preference determines the correct path.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e95b29726167e18a5b3490ad6c677603c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="e776c0b85c33a9431452a922f33b3bea3">
<code>questions</code> – JSON array of question objects. Each object must have the following: <code>question</code>, <code>type</code>, and <code>options</code>. Example: <code>[{"question": "What is your goal?", "type": "single_select", "options": ["A", "B"]}]</code>
</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8344372e9b4008fc8caf88389c34c2f2">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="effc28808e73cce8b4e27d99df9bd023e"><em>I need a blog post. Can you ask me what tone and audience I want before you start writing?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e242005b3d03941ef3b03b51dc8450cee"><em>Before creating the campaign brief, ask me which channels and goals apply.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e096a174e08d1c30c6e5557ce5518493c"><em>Help me choose the right experiment type for my homepage redesign.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eae841969c8dde31202e04e176ee261e8"><em>Ask me which content formats I want before building the editorial calendar.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee9edc619a1484c24acbb4d70388339bb"><em>I’m not sure what kind of report I need. Can you ask me a few questions first?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><h3 id="h_01KR1ZR3HPHE6NXQFAZQFP15CE">Content display<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KR1ZR3HPHE6NXQFAZQFP15CE"></a></h3><div class="beta">The content display tools are in beta. Contact your Customer Success Manager for more information.</div><details><summary><code>present_images</code> – Displays generated or edited images to the user as a rich visual card in the chat interface. Call this tool after <code>generate_or_edit_image</code> when images are the final output.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e67fa4a3f50b3e76d2d7ff826fe0de6b2">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efcad9b2444a82ebf92253e01833c4b6c">Display the results of an image generation or editing task as the final deliverable.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5dfebf9b214ef97e40c1a6c789d3ab18">Present a collection of image variants, for example, multiple hero image options for a campaign, in a carousel or grid.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4fb6b5faf7fa97860c2d1a63c4028f20">Show a single generated image after applying edits such as style transfer, object manipulation, or aspect ratio changes.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e609fe321e45563db5c2fb3366482290f">Surface a set of branded visuals so the user can review and select a preferred option.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecfd43c1b2c7d0a5a8d329593bb9ff3e9">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec401465e5e54363899af6addf2baf249">
<code>image_links</code> – Ordered list of image file links from the <code>generate_or_edit_image</code> tool results.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eee847f136dbde16da421da43b6d9cbc1">
<code>title</code> – Short five to six word title for the image collection. Sentence case, no quotes.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea748070984e98d7cb804bf8d3c259fe3">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e38774e20b7997949f42cedefbf486cf8"><em>Generate three hero image variants for our Spring 2026 campaign and show them to me.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e918fb097d50a71b733e5740c6c31e70b"><em>Create a product shot on a white background and display it.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eda977467feb6355240a33b6e9e510a22"><em>Edit this banner image to remove the background, then show me the result.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edb91ee879b3f39aa5bb532119e952d96"><em>Generate a 16:9 social media graphic for our webinar and present it.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef8cba4dada995dc00d2a99f24ab6c12e"><em>Show me four variations of our logo on a dark background.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><details><summary><code>present_files</code> – Present files to you with a rich visual card.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef594dcf72cdf798d4a2e0296d0130f46">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef13363c5d1e8fb1cbf812bb256ba210f">Display the final generated document or data file requested by you.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed45ce351785ee139d3c4dec7a5f2c3e5">Display a rich visual carousel of images generated or edited during the conversation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e84b7c2b73941155f12f9af42b968d68b">Present a collection of outputs, for example, a chart and a report clearly with download links.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3e8e2564d028bfa2346e9daeb7d476fa">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e85c6e2be85ea414bdefb88bacaf5d4f1">
<code>files</code> – JSON array of file objects. Each object must have the following: <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e639440df2da2fec55f9e87b5533783a3">
<code>name</code> – String, the filename including its extension. For example, <code>chart.png</code>, <code>plan.md</code>, or <code>deck.pptx</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eef82c8d39cf8d55ce4a4eeb9deb959ae">(Optional) <code>mime_type</code> – String.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb3ababb8210b9ef04179b02a6da3eaa9">Each object must also have one of the following to identify the file: <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e67e3d0a5db2c50554b7ae592cdfa4fdd">
<code>path</code> – Workspace path from the <code>code_execute</code> tool. For example, <code>output/chart.png</code> from <code>workspace_files[].path</code>. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9fc03139ea404556a0dbb095c20c0afd">
<code>file_id</code> – File-server UUID. The <code>file_id</code> from <code>FileMetadata</code> or the <code>file_link</code> from <code>link</code> from <code>FileMetadata</code> </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea250681529137573ad2a61a7d60f9346">Examples <code>code_execute</code> – <code>[{"name": "chart.png", "path": "output/chart.png", "mime_type": "image/png"}]</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4c079cbcb2caa356e69f360b54fb0d6e">Example <code>file-server</code> – <code>[{"name": "hero.png", "file_id": "abc-123", "mime_type": "image/png"}]</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ead8aa5196564d69dc8a1c630abd8679e">Example with<code> link</code> – <code>[{"name": "report.pdf", "file_link": "https://.../v1/file/abc-123"}]</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3d6d18f17443fa8c2f410e637ffcd3c9">
<code>title</code> – Short five to six word title for the file collection. Sentence case, no quotes.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e73c0b86e91c80eca080649f1537ae35e">(Optional) <code>display_mode</code> – How to display the files. Use <code>carousel</code> when all files are images. Use <code>list</code> for documents, data files, or mixed types.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4b4f83f0edaacd69d29aa058c6b11bda">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3490e0467ce92389d142385735011f00"><em>Present the generated report file, for example, so I can review and download the PDF.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9e2b5eb76a56fb5136ec2a7a50d06ef0">
<em>Show the three newly created hero images, for example, using the </em><code><em>carousel</em></code><em> display mode.</em>
</li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec5dc35e2fa39eba570b0839dc09ce032"><em>Can you display the data files, for example, providing the title "Q3 Financial Data Export"?</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>present_widget</code> – Renders a data widget, such as a chart, table, metric card, or card list inline in the chat interface.</summary><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e22a81785238f25344c763b4961d4440b">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb352f10f80a04fbdb1ef3082d42f1038">Render a structured data table or metric summary card directly in the chat.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4583ac35550405c3d2254d4fad03dc5a">Present a dashboard-style visualization, for example, campaign performance by channel, after executing analysis code.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e98664b605bef417784d7e61117343986">Surface aggregated experiment results or A/B test metrics in a visual card format.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1d81e7efdd3b24ec7fa2af268f1f4cf8">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed890a6c7e984838a4a9c30b28f5d4fbf">
<code>element_id</code> – Space-Elements element ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ce39946f58a953c6b4639bb7819651a">
<code>space_id</code> – Space-Elements space ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e27d48d1aaece314b9aecc32ac1a59615">
<code>title</code> – Display title for the widget.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed4731a508a278705e336ecd2513066c9">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed1655742b1f5ff1ac2249a26c30d342d"><em>Show me a bar chart of our experiment results by variation for Q2 2026.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee79d71437c7f33fc4bfb179bfb7db1b4"><em>Generate a table summarizing campaign performance by channel and display it in chat.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebb977b0c595397dafb09c152283e1f1f"><em>Create a metric card showing our current conversion rate and present it.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9ab1a1e56f3e417b06a2e38f7ba37fe4"><em>Visualize the revenue breakdown by product category as a pie chart.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e83e551ec6f08d426eb2c5257f7123455"><em>Build a dashboard card showing weekly active users over the last 30 days.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></details><div class="note"><p>If you use Opti ID, administrators can turn off generative AI in the Opti ID Admin Center. See <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36402464751501" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Turn generative AI off across Optimizely applications</a>.</p></div>

<template id="tmpl-article-list">
  <div class="border-top border-bottom lg:border-transparent my-5" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: false })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

    
    <h3 class="flex align-items-center justify-content-between my-4 font-size-lg cursor-pointer lg:hidden" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#sidebar-article-navigation" aria-controls="sidebar-article-navigation" aria-expanded="false">
      Categories
      <svg class="fill-current pointer-events-none ml-3" :class="isOpen && 'rotate-180'" width="14px" viewBox="0 0 40 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M20,19.5 C19.4,19.5 18.9,19.3 18.4,18.9 L1.4,4.9 C0.3,4 0.2,2.4 1.1,1.4 C2,0.3 3.6,0.2 4.6,1.1 L20,13.8 L35.5,1.1 C36.6,0.2 38.1,0.4 39,1.4 C39.9,2.5 39.7,4 38.7,4.9 L21.7,18.9 C21.1,19.3 20.5,19.5 20,19.5 Z" fill-rule="nonzero"></path>
      </svg>
    </h3>

    <div class="collapse lg:expand lg:flex-column" id="sidebar-article-navigation">
      <ul class="list-unstyled font-size-lg w-full">
        <% categories.forEach(function(category, index) { %>
          <li class="font-semibold" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: <%= !!category.isActive %> })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

            
            <div class="flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
              <a class="flex-1 py-3 text-inherit" :class="{ 'text-inherit': !isOpen }" href="<%= category.html_url %>">
                <%= category.name %>
              </a>
              <button class="p-2 ml-1 not-a-button border-radius transition cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-200 hidden lg:block" :class="{ 'is-active': isOpen }" :aria-expanded="isOpen" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#category-<%= category.id %>">
                <svg class="text-inherit fill-current pointer-events-none" :class="{ 'rotate-180': isOpen }" width="12px" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 324 190" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M162,190 C156,190 150,187 146,183 L7,38 C-2,29 -2,15 7,7 C16,-2 30,-2 39,7 L162,135 L285,7 C293,-2 308,-2 317,7 C326,15 326,29 317,38 L178,183 C174,187 168,190 162,190 Z"></path>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div class="hidden lg:block">
              
              <%= partial('partial-article-list-sections', {
                id: 'category-' + category.id,
                parentId: '#sidebar-article-navigation',
                sections: category.sections,
                activeCategoryId: activeCategoryId,
                activeSectionId: activeSectionId,
                activeArticleId: activeArticleId,
                partial: partial
              }) %>
            </div>
          </li>
        <% }); %>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>


<template id="tmpl-section-list">
  <% var maxSections =  5 %>
  <div class="border-top border-bottom lg:border-transparent my-5" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: false })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

    
    <h3 class="flex align-items-center justify-content-between my-4 font-size-lg cursor-pointer lg:hidden" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#sidebar-section-navigation" aria-controls="sidebar-section-navigation" aria-expanded="false">
      Toggle navigation menu
      <svg class="fill-current pointer-events-none ml-3" :class="isOpen && 'rotate-180'" width="14px" viewBox="0 0 40 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M20,19.5 C19.4,19.5 18.9,19.3 18.4,18.9 L1.4,4.9 C0.3,4 0.2,2.4 1.1,1.4 C2,0.3 3.6,0.2 4.6,1.1 L20,13.8 L35.5,1.1 C36.6,0.2 38.1,0.4 39,1.4 C39.9,2.5 39.7,4 38.7,4.9 L21.7,18.9 C21.1,19.3 20.5,19.5 20,19.5 Z" fill-rule="nonzero"></path>
      </svg>
    </h3>

    <div class="collapse lg:expand lg:flex-column" id="sidebar-section-navigation">
      <ul class="list-unstyled m-0 py-2">
        <% categories.forEach(function(category, index) { %>
          <li>
            <h3 class="font-size-lg <% if (index === 0) { %>mt-4<% } else { %>mt-6<% } %>">
              <a class="text-inherit" href="<%= category.html_url %>">
                <%= category.name %>
              </a>
            </h3>
            <%= partial('partial-section-list-sections', { parent: category, sections: category.sections, maxSections: maxSections, partial: partial }) %>
          </li>
        <% }); %>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<template id="tmpl-partial-article-list-sections">
  <% if (sections.length) { %>
    <ul class="list-none pl-3 mb-0 font-size-base collapse" id="<%= id %>" :class="{ 'is-visible': isOpen }" data-parent="<%= parentId %>">
      <% sections.forEach(function(section) { %>
        <li class="font-medium" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: <%= !!section.isActive %> })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

          
          <div class="flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
            <a class="flex-1 py-2 text-inherit font-semibold" :class="{ 'text-inherit': !isOpen }" href="<%= section.html_url %>">
              <%= section.name %>
            </a>
            <button class="p-2 ml-1 not-a-button border-radius transition cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-200" :class="{ 'is-active': isOpen }" :aria-expanded="isOpen" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#section-<%= section.id %>">
              <svg class="text-inherit fill-current pointer-events-none" :class="{ 'rotate-180': isOpen }" width="12px" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 324 190" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M162,190 C156,190 150,187 146,183 L7,38 C-2,29 -2,15 7,7 C16,-2 30,-2 39,7 L162,135 L285,7 C293,-2 308,-2 317,7 C326,15 326,29 317,38 L178,183 C174,187 168,190 162,190 Z"></path>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          
          <%= partial('partial-article-list-sections', {
            id: 'section-' + section.id,
            parentId: '#' + id,
            sections: section.sections,
            activeCategoryId: activeCategoryId,
            activeSectionId: activeSectionId,
            activeArticleId: activeArticleId,
            partial: partial
          }) %>

          
          <% if (section.articles.length) { %>
            <ul class="list-none font-size-md pl-0 mb-0 collapse" :class="{ 'is-visible': isOpen }" id="section-<%= section.id %>" data-parent="#<%= id %>">
              <% section.articles.forEach(function(article) { %>
                <li>
                  <a class="block px-3 py-2 text-inherit border-radius transition<% if (article.isActive) { %> bg-gray-100<% } %>" href="<%= article.html_url %>">
                    <%= article.title %>
                  </a>
                </li>
              <% }); %>
            </ul>
          <% } %>

        </li>
      <% }); %>
    </ul>
  <% } %>
</template>


<template id="tmpl-partial-section-list-sections">
  <% if (sections.length) { %>
    <ul class="list-unstyled font-size-md<% if (parent.hasOwnProperty('parent_section_id')) { %> pl-4 mb-0<% } %>">
      <% sections.slice(0, maxSections).forEach(function(section) { %>
        <li>
          <a class="block py-2 text-inherit<% if (section.isActive) { %> border-left border-left-primary border-left-4 -ml-4 pl-3<% } %>" href="<%= section.html_url %>">
            <%= section.name %>
          </a>
          <%= partial('partial-section-list-sections', { parent: section, sections: section.sections, maxSections: maxSections, partial: partial }) %>
        </li>
      <% }); %>
      <% if (sections.length > maxSections) { %>
        <li>
          <a class="block py-2 text-inherit" href="<%= parent.html_url %>">
            See more
          </a>
        </li>
      <% } %>
    </ul>
  <% } %>
</template>
